headline: Stocks Slip as AI Concerns and US Midterm Elections Keep Investors Cautious
summary: Global equities slipped as ongoing jitters surrounding artificial intelligence and the US midterm elections kept investors on edge.
why: Uncertainty surrounding political shifts and high capital expenditures in technology can dampen broader market sentiment.
why_moved: Equities retreated as investors weighed political uncertainty from the US midterms alongside valuation concerns in artificial intelligence.
